notes_list.title: Major Bilateral Def-Ex Protocols
notes_list.basic_overview: • Malabar Exercise: Quad Nations (India, USA, Japan, Australia). • Samudra Shakti: India & Indonesia bilateral naval operation. • Vajra Prahar: India & US Special Forces engagement.
notes_list.extra_info_content:
📡 Quick Operational Notes:
- Yudh Abhyas is the army exercise between India and USA.
- Surya Kiran is conducted annually between India and Nepal.
- Garuda Shakti (Army) vs Samudra Shakti (Navy) both involve Indonesia—don't get confused!
